pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you're ready. No hidden fees, cancel anytime.

enterprise.title: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Custom contracts, SLAs and onboarding for large teams.

items.a: Yes — upgrade or downgrade anytime from your dashboard. Changes are prorated automatically.
Every paid plan comes with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
Starter has a 2% transaction fee. Growth and Scale include 0% platform fees — you only pay your payment provider.
Cards, wallets, bank transfers and local methods across 130+ currencies via our global checkout.

features.title: Engineered for
features.subtitle: Everything you need to run high-converting, localized e-commerce storefronts across every continent.

localization.title: Native Multi-Language & Bi-Directional RTL
localization.body: Deliver instant localized experiences with subpath routing, automatic IP-based locale detection, and full right-to-left UI mirroring for Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian markets.

ai.title: AI Commerce Copilot
ai.body: Generate SEO-optimized product titles, descriptions, and category tags in seconds. Automatically translate catalogs into 30+ languages with contextual accuracy.

currency.title: Dynamic Multi-Currency & Local Rails
currency.body: Show native pricing in 135+ currencies with automated live forex rates and localized checkout methods including wallets, UPI, and bank transfers.

edge.title: Sub-Second Global Edge Infrastructure
edge.body: Deployed across 320+ edge nodes worldwide with automated inventory locking and 99.999% uptime guarantees to ensure zero overselling during flash sales.

gallery.title: Choose Your
gallery.subtitle: Professionally crafted, conversion-ready storefront themes — filter by industry, preview the features, and launch your live demo in one click.

howItWorks.title: Start selling globally in
howItWorks.subtitle: From signup to your first international order — the whole journey takes less than an afternoon.

steps.title: Create your store
steps.body: Sign up in 60 seconds and launch a fully localized storefront — no code, no setup fees.

steps.title: Connect your channels
steps.body: Plug into marketplaces, payment gateways and logistics partners through direct API links.

steps.title: Add your products
steps.body: Bulk-import catalogs in one go — AI writes SEO titles, descriptions and translations for you.

steps.title: Sell worldwide
steps.body: Live forex pricing, edge-fast checkout and zero-oversell inventory across every region.
